evidence.source: Produced by mav-replay (examples/replay_dump) from mixed_history_v2.capture.json; values checked by hand: current_bpm 62 is the newest realtime second, mean 60.5 bpm over HRs 60/61/62/59, the duplicated historical chunk stores nothing, and the stale-clock record keeps its raw device time while falling back to the capture wall. v2 rebuilds the v1 realtime frame at the payload-relative offsets the [WRS] real captures pin; the historical chunks are byte-identical to v1, and the snapshot and hash equal v1's exactly.
